The dish looks like spaghetti squash, or possibly shredded chicken, baked in tomato sauce with vegetables. The strands are pale and stringy, which fits spaghetti squash, but the mix could also be shredded chicken in tomato sauce. I judged it a casserole of tomato sauce, shredded chicken, and vegetables.

For size, the plate is about 26 cm across. The food covers roughly 15 cm by 13 cm, and it is thin, about 2 cm high. That gives an area of about 150 cm², or about 300 cm³. A loose pile of this kind is roughly 60% solid, so I estimate about 190 g.

For energy, I split it into two items: shredded chicken at about 40% of the weight, and tomato sauce with vegetables and squash at the rest. Combined, that comes to roughly 110–120 kcal per 100 g, so I used a single mixed-dish estimate of 115 kcal per 100 g. I split it as follows:
- Shredded chicken: about 80 g at 165 kcal per 100 g.
- Tomato sauce, vegetables and squash: about 120 g at 70 kcal per 100 g.
